feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
entry.summary: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

entry.title: Can Black voting power and Trump fatigue break Mississippi's red wall?
entry.summary: Mississippi has the largest proportional Black population in the country. It's one reason the U.S. Senate race has seen millions in last-minute spending and high-profile campaign visits.

entry.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
entry.summary: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

entry.title: Some Michigan residents remain hopeful despite being hit hard by Trump's tariffs
entry.summary: Michigan households are paying the highest cost per household for the Trump administration's tariffs. For the voters paying the price, the issue isn't cut-and-dry.

entry.title: As campaign rhetoric escalates, Michigan voters say they're burned out
entry.summary: From college football tailgates to conversations in Ann Arbor, Michigan voters tell NPR they're worried about everyday costs, frustrated with the two-party system and increasingly reluctant to discuss politics openly.

entry.title: When an invasive fish is also tasty, Maryland schoolkids can help 'eat the problem'
entry.summary: The Chesapeake Bay, home to blue crabs and striped bass, has a new apex predator: the blue catfish. It's invasive and voracious. It's also delicious, which officials hope might help save the bay.

entry.title: Trump administration pushes for food assistance card upgrade to fight fraud
entry.summary: The proposed rule is a major step forward in addressing a form of fraud that has robbed SNAP recipients of millions.

entry.title: Four Corners region faces flood threat after days of heavy rain
entry.summary: The area where four states meet in the U.S. Southwest remains on a flood watch after days of heavy rain and winds.

entry.title: How AI is transforming hurricane forecasts
entry.summary: Hurricane forecasters are increasingly using artificial intelligence to make predictions.

entry.title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
entry.summary: Republicans redrew congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.
